method: Coverage mapping only. No semantic re-litigation of WF-1..WF-7. A lens counts as covering a job only with a job-specific finding or explicit per-job no-finding note. An empty pass with no notes counts as no evidence (Hoare: no proof claim without the invariant; Alexander: fit must be shown in the built place, not asserted). Advisory weighed: the claim that raw evidence names workflow files only for devops/security was checked against .outline/audit/queue.json rawResults and not adopted: code-quality names ci.yml:27 (WF-1), performance names release.yml:60/234 (WF-4/WF-5), security names release.yml:167/160 (WF-6/WF-7), devops names ci.yml:27 and release.yml:142 (WF-2/WF-3); test-quality names nothing. Coverage below rests on those per-job citations, never on reviewer selection alone.

realGaps.statement: No lens examines the deny job and no parent command executes cargo deny this run. Pin/install and policy-gate behavior are unexamined in the current audit.

No lens examines the test matrix (clippy -D warnings, cargo test, release build, release-binary self-lint, fail-fast false, MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET). Test-quality pass is empty with no per-job all-clear, so the audit's highest test surface has zero current attestation.
No lens examines the sbom job (installer pin, per-target loop, binary-target assertion, Cargo.lock guard, upload globs) and nothing executes it this run.
No lens examines the reusable-call wiring (needs verify-tag gate, permissions override). Transitive coverage fails because the underlying deny/test jobs are themselves gaps.

test-quality empty pass with no notes cannot be cited as coverage for any job. Any closure claim of the form 'five lenses reviewed the workflows' is unjustified until tq records per-job verdicts or its silence is explicitly scoped to consulted-prior-findings.

partialsNotGaps: ci.yml/release-scripts and release.yml/verify-tag: scripts executed (63/63 + shellcheck), job wiring not lens-examined; prior D1/T-series consulted but not re-attested. Record as partial, close by adding one line per job or citing the consulted prior commit.

unjustifiedExecutionClaims.claim: queue.json 4-command verification array proves the workflows
unjustifiedExecutionClaims.verdict: unjustified if read that way. The array proves syntax (actionlint), script logic (selftest/shellcheck), and fmt only. It contains no deny, matrix, or tag-job execution. The parent doc avoids this misreading by disclosing non-execution; any closure statement must carry the same disclosure.

verdict: Coverage is not closed. 4 of 10 job entries are full gaps (deny, test matrix, sbom, reusable ci call); 3 are partial (release-scripts, verify-tag, build/attest wiring). Covered without new work: lint, publish (with disclosed hosted-execution limit), attest-permissions/provenance. Do not claim five-lens closure until G-1..G-5 are answered with per-job notes or targeted evidence; add no workflow or abstraction changes to satisfy a coverage pass (Alexander: no layer that moves the complexity; Hoare: assert only the invariant shown).
